requirements_summary.title: Recombinant DNA & Genetic Manipulation Oversight
requirements_summary.description: Use of engineered plasmids, viral or bacterial vectors, or CRISPR genetic alterations necessitates institutional biosafety committee (IBC) registration and containment assessment.
requirements_summary.applicable_annex: Annex C: Genetic Modification & Recombinant Vectors
requirements_summary.evidence: Recombinant indicator: 'Potential secondary structure in crRNA.'
requirements_summary.human_action_required: Institutional Biosafety Officer must confirm vector safety profile and host containment verification.

requirements_summary.title: Antimicrobial Resistance Determinants & Pathogen Containment
requirements_summary.description: Work with multidrug-resistant isolates (e.g. mcr-1 colistin resistance) or opportunistic pathogens presents dual-use and laboratory-acquired infection risks requiring minimum BSL-2 precautions.
requirements_summary.applicable_annex: Annex C: Biosafety Level 2 Protocol Verification
requirements_summary.evidence: Recombinant indicator: 'Potential secondary structure in crRNA.'
requirements_summary.human_action_required: Biosafety Officer must inspect standard operating procedures (SOPs) for biohazard autoclaving and barrier protection.
